meta.name: kpi-dashboard-design
meta.description: Design effective KPI dashboards with metrics selection, visualization best practices, and real-time monitoring patterns. Use this skill when building an executive SaaS metrics dashboard tracking MRR, churn, and LTV/CAC ratios; designing an operations center with live service health and request throughput; creating a cohort retention analysis view for a product team; or debugging a dashboard where metrics contradict each other due to inconsistent calculation methodology.

copy.tagline: 设计出反映业务关键指标的优质仪表板
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要为客户或团队搭建业务数据看板
copy.tagline_en: Design a clear dashboard for your key business metrics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build a clear data dashboard for your business.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你设计 KPI 仪表盘:按战略/战术/运营分层挑选指标,给出布局层级示例(高管概览、部门视图、下钻),并排查指标互相矛盾、实时刷新拖慢数据库等常见问题。
howto.when: 当你设计高管或部门级 KPI 仪表盘、搭建实时监控视图,或排查指标口径不一致导致数字互相矛盾时接管。

say.text: 帮我设计一个追踪 MRR、流失率和 LTV/CAC 的高管仪表盘
say.note: 会按战略/战术/运营分层给指标与布局建议

say.text: 仪表盘上的 MRR 和财务口径对不上,帮我排查一下
say.note: 定位口径不一致的算法并给出统一公式

say.text: 实时仪表盘每 10 秒刷新,把数据库拖慢了,怎么改
say.note: 给出预聚合汇总表方案

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude designs KPI dashboards: selects metrics by strategic/tactical/operational layer, sketches layout hierarchies (exec summary, department views, drilldowns), and troubleshoots contradictory metrics or real-time refresh load.
howto.when_en: Use when designing an executive or department KPI dashboard, building a live monitoring view, or debugging dashboards whose numbers disagree due to inconsistent calculation methodology.

say_en.text: Design an executive dashboard tracking MRR, churn, and LTV/CAC.
say_en.note: Suggests metrics and layout by layer

say_en.text: Our dashboard MRR disagrees with finance — help me debug it.
The live dashboard refreshes every 10s and slows the database.
